title: Pricing · credits and tokens
description: Usage/credits surface for routing tokens and other metered consumption. Two side-by-side cards: included monthly allowance per plan with overage rate, and discrete token packs with per-token economics. Distinct from pricing.addons-bundles, which is for capacity packs, not consumable usage.

source.adapted_from: Information architecture reference only — Attio's credits and add-on system. ServiceWand surfaces credits as a dedicated section because the routing tool's token economics need to be visible separately from buildings/seats add-ons.
source.decision: Stage 1 pricing scaffold — new block, no equivalent in the existing pricing.* family.

notes: Credits live in their own block because routing tokens are consumable usage, not capacity. Add-on packs go in pricing.addons-bundles.
Allowance rows and pack tiers can each be hidden via *_visible ENUMs. Pack 4 is hidden by default.
The block declares data-pricing-period but does not own a toggle — it only listens for cross-block billing events so future per-period rate variants can be wired in.
